title: Collection Book Manager
description: Upgrade heroes, weapons, traps and more to a target level — one item, whole section, or everything at once. Sections mirror the Collection Book layout.
note: Uses account XP. Max level depends on star tier (e.g. 5★ = 50). Supercharged items can go higher. Slotting puts items into the Collection Book permanently for that template.

slot.title: Slot into Collection Book?
slot.description: {{count}} item(s) will be slotted into the Collection Book. This is permanent: the items are removed from your inventory. Favorited items are skipped. Aerial can't check whether these items are already in your Collection Book.

upgrade.title: Upgrade items?
upgrade.description: {{count}} item(s) will be upgraded to level {{level}} (or their max level, if lower). This spends Hero, Schematic or Survivor XP and can't be undone.

toasts.error_fetch: Could not load the account inventory
toasts.error_upgrade: Upgrade failed (not enough XP or item locked)
toasts.error_slot: Could not slot into Collection Book
toasts.error_slot-empty: Nothing to slot (favorited items are never slotted)
toasts.error_nothing: Nothing to upgrade at this target level
